[1923](#1923)async fn chatter_gate(
[1927](#1927)    state: &AppState,
[1928](#1928)    backend: &DataBackend,
[1929](#1929)    ctx: &Ctx,
[1930](#1930)    name: &str,
[1931](#1931)    id: i64,
[1932](#1932)) -> Result<(), Response> {
[1933](#1933)    let host = resolve_model(state, name)?;
[1934](#1934)    if !is_mailed(name) {
[1935](#1935)        return Err((StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, format!("model '{name}' has no mail thread")).into_response());
[1936](#1936)    }
[1937](#1937)    match backend.db.find_one_secured(&host, ctx, &backend.acls(), &backend.rules(), id).await {
[1938](#1938)        Ok(Some(_)) => Ok(()),
[1939](#1939)        Ok(None) => Err((StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "not found or not permitted").into_response()),
[1940](#1940)        Err(DbError::AccessDenied { .. }) => Err((StatusCode::FORBIDDEN, "access denied").into_response()),
[1941](#1941)        Err(e) => Err(internal_error("chatter-gate", e)),
[1942](#1942)    }

[1945](#1945)fn thread_filter(name: &str, id: i64) -> Domain {
[1947](#1947)    Domain::Cond(Condition { field: "res_model".into(), op: Operator::Eq, value: Value::Str(name.to_string()) })
[1948](#1948)        .and(Domain::Cond(Condition { field: "res_id".into(), op: Operator::Eq, value: Value::Int(id) }))
[1949](#1949)}
[1950](#1950)
[1951](#1951)fn header_safe(s: &str, fallback: &str) -> String {
[1954](#1954)    let cleaned: String =
[1955](#1955)        s.chars().filter(|c| c.is_ascii() && !c.is_ascii_control() && *c != '"').collect();
[1956](#1956)    if cleaned.trim().is_empty() {
[1957](#1957)        fallback.to_string()
[1958](#1958)    } else {
[1959](#1959)        cleaned
[1960](#1960)    }

[1963](#1963)async fn attachment_gate(

[1980](#1980)        Ok(None) => Err((StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "not found or not permitted").into_response()),
[1981](#1981)        Err(DbError::AccessDenied { .. }) => Err((StatusCode::FORBIDDEN, "access denied").into_response()),
[1982](#1982)        Err(e) => Err(internal_error("attachment-gate", e)),

[2020](#2020)async fn upload_attachment_handler(
[2023](#2023)    State(state): State<AppState>,
[2024](#2024)    Path((name, id)): Path<(String, i64)>,
[2025](#2025)    headers: HeaderMap,
[2026](#2026)    body: Bytes,
[2027](#2027)) -> Response {
[2028](#2028)    let (backend, ctx, att) = match attachment_setup(&state, &headers, &name, id, true).await {
[2029](#2029)        Ok(t) => t,
[2030](#2030)        Err(r) => return r,
[2031](#2031)    };
[2032](#2032)    if body.is_empty() {
[2033](#2033)        return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "empty upload").into_response();
[2034](#2034)    }
[2035](#2035)    let filename = headers.get("x-filename").and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok()).unwrap_or("file").to_string();
[2036](#2036)    let mimetype = headers.get("content-type").and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok()).unwrap_or("application/octet-stream").to_string();
[2037](#2037)    let sha = sha256_hex(&body);
[2038](#2038)    if let Err(e) = backend.blobs.put(&sha, &body).await {
[2040](#2040)        return internal_error("attachment-put", e);
[2041](#2041)    }
[2042](#2042)    let su = ctx.sudo();
[2043](#2043)    let payload = serde_json::json!({
[2044](#2044)        "name": filename,
[2045](#2045)        "res_model": name,
[2046](#2046)        "res_id": id,
[2047](#2047)        "mimetype": mimetype,
[2048](#2048)        "file_size": body.len() as i64,
[2049](#2049)        "checksum": sha,
[2050](#2050)    });
[2051](#2051)    match backend.db.insert_secured(att, &su, &backend.acls(), &backend.rules(), payload.as_object().unwrap()).await {
[2052](#2052)        Ok(aid) => json_status(
[2053](#2053)            StatusCode::CREATED,
[2054](#2054)            serde_json::json!({ "id": aid, "name": filename, "mimetype": mimetype, "file_size": body.len(), "checksum": sha }).to_string(),
[2055](#2055)        ),
[2056](#2056)        Err(e) => write_error("attachment", e),
[2057](#2057)    }
[2058](#2058)}
[2059](#2059)
[2060](#2060)async fn download_attachment_handler(
[2062](#2062)    State(state): State<AppState>,
[2063](#2063)    Path(aid): Path<i64>,
[2064](#2064)    headers: HeaderMap,
[2065](#2065)) -> Response {
[2066](#2066)    let backend = state.data.as_ref().expect("data backend present on data routes");
[2067](#2067)    let ctx = match authenticate(backend, &headers) {
[2068](#2068)        Ok(c) => c,
[2069](#2069)        Err(r) => return r,
[2070](#2070)    };
[2071](#2071)    let att = match served_model(&state, "ir.attachment") {
[2072](#2072)        Ok(m) => m,
[2073](#2073)        Err(r) => return r,
[2074](#2074)    };
[2075](#2075)    let su = ctx.sudo();
[2077](#2077)    let row = match backend.db.find_one_secured(att, &su, &backend.acls(), &backend.rules(), aid).await {
[2078](#2078)        Ok(Some(r)) => r,
[2079](#2079)        Ok(None) => return (StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "attachment not found").into_response(),
[2080](#2080)        Err(e) => return write_error("attachment", e),
[2081](#2081)    };
[2082](#2082)    let res_model = row.get("res_model").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
[2083](#2083)    let res_id = row.get("res_id").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).unwrap_or(0);
[2084](#2084)    if let Err(r) = attachment_gate(&state, backend, &ctx, res_model, res_id, false).await {
[2085](#2085)        return r;
[2086](#2086)    }
[2087](#2087)    let checksum = row.get("checksum").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
[2088](#2088)    let mimetype = header_safe(row.get("mimetype").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or(""), "application/octet-stream");
[2089](#2089)    let filename = header_safe(row.get("name").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or(""), "file");
[2090](#2090)    let disposition = match mimetype.as_str() {
[2094](#2094)        "image/png" | "image/jpeg" | "image/gif" | "image/webp" | "application/pdf" => "inline",
[2095](#2095)        _ => "attachment",
[2096](#2096)    };
[2097](#2097)    match backend.blobs.get(checksum).await {
[2098](#2098)        Ok(bytes) => (
[2099](#2099)            [
[2100](#2100)                ("content-type", mimetype),
[2101](#2101)                ("content-disposition", format!("{disposition}; filename=\"{filename}\"")),
[2102](#2102)                ("x-content-type-options", "nosniff".to_string()),
[2103](#2103)            ],
[2104](#2104)            bytes,
[2105](#2105)        )
[2106](#2106)            .into_response(),
[2107](#2107)        Err(e) => internal_error("attachment-get", e),
[2108](#2108)    }
[2109](#2109)}
[2110](#2110)

[2145](#2145)async fn messages_handler(
[2147](#2147)    State(state): State<AppState>,
[2148](#2148)    Path((name, id)): Path<(String, i64)>,
[2149](#2149)    headers: HeaderMap,
[2150](#2150)) -> Response {
[2151](#2151)    let (backend, ctx, mail) = match chatter_setup(&state, &headers, &name, id, "mail.message").await {
[2152](#2152)        Ok(t) => t,
[2153](#2153)        Err(r) => return r,
[2154](#2154)    };
[2155](#2155)    let su = ctx.sudo();
[2158](#2158)    let filter = thread_filter(&name, id);
[2159](#2159)    match backend.db.find_secured(mail, &su, &backend.acls(), &backend.rules(), Some(&filter)).await {
[2160](#2160)        Ok(rows) => {
[2161](#2161)            let ids: Vec<i64> = rows.iter().filter_map(|m| m.get("id").and_then(|v| v.as_i64())).collect();
[2164](#2164)            let tracking = match backend.db.tracking_for(&ids).await {
[2165](#2165)                Ok(t) => t,
[2166](#2166)                Err(e) => {
[2167](#2167)                    eprintln!("kigumi-server messages tracking enrichment failed: {e:?}");
[2169](#2169)                    Vec::new()
[2170](#2170)                }
[2171](#2171)            };
[2172](#2172)            let mut by_msg: HashMap<i64, Vec<Json2>> = HashMap::new();
[2175](#2175)            for t in tracking {
[2176](#2176)                let readable = t
[2177](#2177)                    .get("field")
[2178](#2178)                    .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
[2179](#2179)                    .map(|f| field_accessible(&name, f, &ctx))
[2180](#2180)                    .unwrap_or(false);
[2181](#2181)                if !readable {
[2182](#2182)                    continue;
[2183](#2183)                }
[2184](#2184)                if let Some(mid) = t.get("message_id").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()) {
[2185](#2185)                    by_msg.entry(mid).or_default().push(t);
[2186](#2186)                }
[2187](#2187)            }
[2188](#2188)            let enriched: Vec<Json2> = rows
[2189](#2189)                .into_iter()
[2190](#2190)                .map(|mut m| {
[2191](#2191)                    if let Some(mid) = m.get("id").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()) {
[2192](#2192)                        if let Some(obj) = m.as_object_mut() {
[2193](#2193)                            obj.insert("tracking".into(), Json2::Array(by_msg.remove(&mid).unwrap_or_default()));
[2194](#2194)                        }
[2195](#2195)                    }
[2196](#2196)                    m
[2197](#2197)                })
[2198](#2198)                .collect();
[2199](#2199)            json_response(serde_json::json!({ "data": enriched }).to_string())
[2200](#2200)        }
[2201](#2201)        Err(DbError::AccessDenied { .. }) => (StatusCode::FORBIDDEN, "access denied").into_response(),
[2202](#2202)        Err(e) => internal_error("messages", e),
[2203](#2203)    }
[2204](#2204)}

[2206](#2206)async fn post_message_handler(
[2210](#2210)    State(state): State<AppState>,

[2221](#2221)        _ => return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "message body is required").into_response(),

[2225](#2225)        Some("note") => "note",

[2227](#2227)    };
[2228](#2228)    let now = match backend.db.now().await {
[2229](#2229)        Ok(t) => t,
[2230](#2230)        Err(e) => return internal_error("clock", e),
[2231](#2231)    };

[2237](#2237)    values.insert("message_type".into(), Json2::String(mtype.to_string()));
[2238](#2238)    values.insert("date".into(), Json2::String(now));
[2239](#2239)    let su = ctx.sudo();
[2242](#2242)    match backend.db.insert_secured(mail, &su, &backend.acls(), &backend.rules(), &values).await {
[2243](#2243)        Ok(mid) => json_status(StatusCode::CREATED, format!("{{\"id\": {mid}}}")),
[2244](#2244)        Err(e) => write_error("message", e),
[2245](#2245)    }

[2248](#2248)fn activity_state(deadline: Option<&str>, today: &str) -> &'static str {
[2251](#2251)    match deadline {
[2252](#2252)        Some(d) if d < today => "overdue",
[2253](#2253)        Some(d) if d == today => "today",
[2254](#2254)        _ => "planned", }
[2256](#2256)}

[2258](#2258)async fn activities_handler(

[2277](#2277)    }));

[2297](#2297)async fn schedule_activity_handler(

[2301](#2301)    Path((name, id)): Path<(String, i64)>,
[2302](#2302)    headers: HeaderMap,
[2303](#2303)    Json(body): Json<Json2>,
[2304](#2304)) -> Response {
[2305](#2305)    let (backend, ctx, act) = match chatter_setup(&state, &headers, &name, id, "mail.activity").await {
[2306](#2306)        Ok(t) => t,

[2311](#2311)        _ => return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "activity summary is required").into_response(),
[2312](#2312)    };
[2313](#2313)    let assignee = match body_user_id(&body, ctx.uid) {
[2315](#2315)        Ok(u) => u,
[2316](#2316)        Err(r) => return r,
[2317](#2317)    };
[2318](#2318)    let mut values = serde_json::Map::new();
[2319](#2319)    values.insert("res_model".into(), Json2::String(name.clone()));

[2335](#2335)async fn activity_done_handler(
[2338](#2338)    State(state): State<AppState>,
[2339](#2339)    Path((name, id, aid)): Path<(String, i64, i64)>,
[2340](#2340)    headers: HeaderMap,
[2341](#2341)) -> Response {
[2342](#2342)    let (backend, ctx, act) = match chatter_setup(&state, &headers, &name, id, "mail.activity").await {
[2343](#2343)        Ok(t) => t,
[2344](#2344)        Err(r) => return r,
[2345](#2345)    };

[2350](#2350)            a.get("res_model").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) == Some(name.as_str())
[2351](#2351)                && a.get("res_id").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()) == Some(id)
[2352](#2352)        }
[2353](#2353)        Ok(None) => false,
[2354](#2354)        Err(e) => return internal_error("activity-done", e),
[2355](#2355)    };
[2356](#2356)    if !belongs {
[2357](#2357)        return (StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "activity not found on this record").into_response();
[2358](#2358)    }
[2359](#2359)    let mut values = serde_json::Map::new();
[2360](#2360)    values.insert("active".into(), Json2::Bool(false));
[2361](#2361)    match backend.db.update_secured(act, &su, &backend.acls(), &backend.rules(), aid, &values).await {
[2362](#2362)        Ok(0) => (StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "activity not found on this record").into_response(),
[2365](#2365)        Ok(_) => json_response("{\"ok\":true}".to_string()),
[2366](#2366)        Err(e) => write_error("activity-done", e),

[2398](#2398)async fn follow_handler(
[2402](#2402)    State(state): State<AppState>,
[2403](#2403)    Path((name, id)): Path<(String, i64)>,
[2404](#2404)    headers: HeaderMap,
[2405](#2405)    Json(body): Json<Json2>,
[2406](#2406)) -> Response {
[2407](#2407)    let (backend, ctx, foll) = match chatter_setup(&state, &headers, &name, id, "mail.follower").await {
[2408](#2408)        Ok(t) => t,
[2409](#2409)        Err(r) => return r,
[2410](#2410)    };
[2411](#2411)    let uid = match body_user_id(&body, ctx.uid) {
[2412](#2412)        Ok(u) => u,
[2413](#2413)        Err(r) => return r,
[2414](#2414)    };
[2415](#2415)    if let Err(r) = ensure_self_or_admin(&ctx, uid) {
[2416](#2416)        return r;
[2417](#2417)    }
[2418](#2418)    let mut values = serde_json::Map::new();
[2419](#2419)    values.insert("res_model".into(), Json2::String(name.clone()));
[2420](#2420)    values.insert("res_id".into(), Json2::Number(id.into()));
[2421](#2421)    values.insert("user_id".into(), Json2::Number(uid.into()));
[2422](#2422)    let su = ctx.sudo();
[2423](#2423)    match backend.db.insert_secured(foll, &su, &backend.acls(), &backend.rules(), &values).await {
[2424](#2424)        Ok(_) => json_status(StatusCode::CREATED, "{\"ok\":true}".to_string()),
[2425](#2425)        Err(DbError::Conflict(_)) => json_response("{\"ok\":true,\"already\":true}".to_string()),
[2427](#2427)        Err(e) => write_error("follow", e),
[2428](#2428)    }

[2431](#2431)async fn unfollow_handler(
[2434](#2434)    State(state): State<AppState>,
[2435](#2435)    Path((name, id)): Path<(String, i64)>,
[2436](#2436)    headers: HeaderMap,
[2437](#2437)    Json(body): Json<Json2>,
[2438](#2438)) -> Response {
[2439](#2439)    let (backend, ctx, foll) = match chatter_setup(&state, &headers, &name, id, "mail.follower").await {
[2440](#2440)        Ok(t) => t,
[2441](#2441)        Err(r) => return r,
[2442](#2442)    };
[2443](#2443)    let uid = match body_user_id(&body, ctx.uid) {
[2444](#2444)        Ok(u) => u,
[2445](#2445)        Err(r) => return r,
[2446](#2446)    };
[2447](#2447)    if let Err(r) = ensure_self_or_admin(&ctx, uid) {
[2448](#2448)        return r;
[2449](#2449)    }
[2450](#2450)    let su = ctx.sudo();
[2451](#2451)    let filter = follower_filter(&name, id, Some(uid));
[2452](#2452)    let ids = match backend.db.find_ids_secured(foll, &su, &backend.acls(), &backend.rules(), Some(&filter)).await {
[2453](#2453)        Ok(v) => v,
[2454](#2454)        Err(e) => return internal_error("unfollow", e),
[2455](#2455)    };
[2456](#2456)    for fid in ids {
[2457](#2457)        if let Err(e) = backend.db.delete_secured(foll, &su, &backend.acls(), &backend.rules(), fid).await {
[2458](#2458)            return write_error("unfollow", e);
[2459](#2459)        }
[2460](#2460)    }
[2461](#2461)    json_response("{\"ok\":true}".to_string())
[2462](#2462)}
[2463](#2463)
[2464](#2464)async fn issue_token_pair(
[2468](#2468)    backend: &DataBackend,
[2469](#2469)    uid: i64,
[2470](#2470)    groups: Vec<String>,
[2471](#2471)    scope: (Option<i64>, Vec<i64>),
[2472](#2472)) -> Response {
[2473](#2473)    let (company, companies) = scope;
[2474](#2474)    let access = match backend.auth.issue_access(uid, groups, company, companies, ACCESS_TTL) {
[2475](#2475)        Ok(t) => t,
[2476](#2476)        Err(_) => return internal_error("token", "issue access"),
[2477](#2477)    };
[2478](#2478)    let jti = new_jti();
[2479](#2479)    if let Err(e) = backend.db.store_refresh(&jti, uid, REFRESH_TTL as i64).await {
[2480](#2480)        return internal_error("refresh-store", e);
[2481](#2481)    }
[2482](#2482)    let refresh = match backend.auth.issue_refresh(uid, &jti, REFRESH_TTL) {
[2483](#2483)        Ok(t) => t,
[2484](#2484)        Err(_) => return internal_error("token", "issue refresh"),
[2485](#2485)    };
[2486](#2486)    let body = serde_json::json!({
[2487](#2487)        "access_token": access,
[2488](#2488)        "refresh_token": refresh,
[2489](#2489)        "token_type": "Bearer",
[2490](#2490)        "expires_in": ACCESS_TTL,
[2491](#2491)    });
[2492](#2492)    json_status(StatusCode::OK, body.to_string())
[2493](#2493)}

[2495](#2495)fn dummy_hash() -> &'static str {
[2498](#2498)    static H: OnceLock<String> = OnceLock::new();
[2499](#2499)    H.get_or_init(|| hash_password("kigumi-timing-equalizer").expect("dummy hash"))
[2500](#2500)}
[2501](#2501)
[2502](#2502)async fn login_handler(State(state): State<AppState>, Json(body): Json<Json2>) -> Response {
[2503](#2503)    let backend = state.data.as_ref().expect("data backend present on auth routes");
[2504](#2504)    let (login, password) = match (str_field(&body, "login"), str_field(&body, "password")) {
[2505](#2505)        (Some(l), Some(p)) => (l, p),
[2506](#2506)        _ => return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "login and password required").into_response(),
[2507](#2507)    };
[2508](#2508)    let user = match backend.db.find_user(login).await {
[2509](#2509)        Ok(u) => u,
[2510](#2510)        Err(e) => return internal_error("login", e),
[2511](#2511)    };
[2512](#2512)    let hash = user.as_ref().map(|u| u.password_hash.as_str()).unwrap_or_else(|| dummy_hash());
[2515](#2515)    let ok = verify_password(password, hash);
[2516](#2516)    match user {
[2517](#2517)        Some(u) if ok => {
[2518](#2518)            let scope = (u.company_id, u.company_ids);
[2519](#2519)            issue_token_pair(backend, u.id, u.groups, scope).await
[2520](#2520)        }
[2521](#2521)        _ => (StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid credentials").into_response(),
[2522](#2522)    }
[2523](#2523)}
[2524](#2524)
[2525](#2525)async fn refresh_handler(State(state): State<AppState>, Json(body): Json<Json2>) -> Response {
[2526](#2526)    let backend = state.data.as_ref().expect("data backend present on auth routes");
[2527](#2527)    let token = match str_field(&body, "refresh_token") {
[2528](#2528)        Some(t) => t,
[2529](#2529)        None => return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "refresh_token required").into_response(),
[2530](#2530)    };
[2531](#2531)    let claims = match backend.auth.verify_refresh(token) {
[2532](#2532)        Ok(c) => c,
[2533](#2533)        Err(_) => return (StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid refresh token").into_response(),
[2534](#2534)    };
[2535](#2535)    match backend.db.claim_refresh(&claims.jti).await {
[2538](#2538)        Ok(Some(uid)) if uid == claims.uid => {
[2539](#2539)            let groups = match backend.db.user_groups(uid).await {
[2540](#2540)                Ok(g) => g,
[2541](#2541)                Err(e) => return internal_error("groups", e),
[2542](#2542)            };
[2543](#2543)            let scope = match backend.db.user_scope(uid).await {
[2545](#2545)                Ok(s) => s,
[2546](#2546)                Err(e) => return internal_error("scope", e),
[2547](#2547)            };
[2548](#2548)            issue_token_pair(backend, uid, groups, scope).await
[2549](#2549)        }
[2550](#2550)        Ok(_) => (StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid refresh token").into_response(),
[2551](#2551)        Err(e) => internal_error("refresh", e),
[2552](#2552)    }
[2553](#2553)}
[2554](#2554)
[2555](#2555)async fn logout_handler(State(state): State<AppState>, Json(body): Json<Json2>) -> Response {
[2556](#2556)    let backend = state.data.as_ref().expect("data backend present on auth routes");
[2557](#2557)    if let Some(token) = str_field(&body, "refresh_token") {
[2559](#2559)        if let Ok(claims) = backend.auth.verify_refresh(token) {
[2560](#2560)            let _ = backend.db.revoke_refresh(&claims.jti).await;
[2561](#2561)        }
[2562](#2562)    }
[2563](#2563)    StatusCode::NO_CONTENT.into_response()
[2564](#2564)}

[2621](#2621)    fn view_overrides_relabel_hide_and_lock() {
[2622](#2622)        let contract = "{\"fields\":[\
[2623](#2623)            {\"name\":\"state\",\"label\":\"State\",\"widget\":\"selection\",\"readonly\":false},\
[2624](#2624)            {\"name\":\"secret\",\"label\":\"Secret\",\"widget\":\"text\",\"readonly\":false}],\
[2625](#2625)            \"list\":{\"columns\":[\
[2626](#2626)            {\"name\":\"state\",\"label\":\"State\",\"widget\":\"selection\"},\
[2627](#2627)            {\"name\":\"secret\",\"label\":\"Secret\",\"widget\":\"text\"}]}}";
[2628](#2628)        let overrides = vec![
[2629](#2629)            ViewOverride {
[2630](#2630)                model: "sale.order".into(),
[2631](#2631)                field: "state".into(),
[2632](#2632)                label: Some("Status".into()),
[2633](#2633)                widget: None,
[2634](#2634)                invisible: false,
[2635](#2635)                readonly: true,
[2636](#2636)                invisible_when: Some("{\"field\":\"state\",\"op\":\"=\",\"value\":\"done\"}".into()),
[2637](#2637)                readonly_when: None,
[2638](#2638)            },
[2639](#2639)            ViewOverride {
[2640](#2640)                model: "sale.order".into(),
[2641](#2641)                field: "secret".into(),
[2642](#2642)                label: None,
[2643](#2643)                widget: None,
[2644](#2644)                invisible: true,
[2645](#2645)                readonly: false,
[2646](#2646)                invisible_when: None,
[2647](#2647)                readonly_when: None,
[2648](#2648)            },
[2649](#2649)        ];
[2650](#2650)        let out = apply_view_overrides(contract, &overrides);
[2651](#2651)        let v: Json2 = serde_json::from_str(&out).unwrap();
[2652](#2652)        let fields = v["fields"].as_array().unwrap();
[2653](#2653)        assert_eq!(fields.len(), 1);
[2655](#2655)        assert_eq!(fields[0]["name"], "state");
[2656](#2656)        assert_eq!(fields[0]["label"], "Status");

[2658](#2658)        assert_eq!(fields[0]["invisible_when"], serde_json::json!({"field":"state","op":"=","value":"done"}));
[2660](#2660)        let cols = v["list"]["columns"].as_array().unwrap();
[2661](#2661)        assert_eq!(cols.len(), 1);
[2662](#2662)        assert_eq!(cols[0]["name"], "state");
[2663](#2663)        assert_eq!(cols[0]["label"], "Status");
[2664](#2664)        let untouched = apply_view_overrides(contract, &[]);
[2666](#2666)        let v2: Json2 = serde_json::from_str(&untouched).unwrap();
[2667](#2667)        assert_eq!(v2["fields"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 2);
[2668](#2668)    }

[2725](#2725)    #[test]
[2726](#2726)    fn parse_query_filter_order_limit() {
[2727](#2727)        let m = model();
[2728](#2728)        let mut p = HashMap::new();
[2729](#2729)        p.insert("state".to_string(), "draft".to_string());
[2730](#2730)        p.insert("amount__gte".to_string(), "10".to_string());
[2731](#2731)        p.insert("order".to_string(), "-id".to_string());
[2732](#2732)        p.insert("limit".to_string(), "5".to_string());
[2733](#2733)        let (filter, order, limit, offset) = parse_list_query(&m, &p).unwrap();
[2734](#2734)        assert!(filter.is_some());
[2735](#2735)        assert_eq!(order, vec![("id".to_string(), true)]);
[2736](#2736)        assert_eq!(limit, 5);
[2737](#2737)        assert_eq!(offset, 0);
[2738](#2738)        assert!(filter.unwrap().compile(&m).is_ok());
[2740](#2740)    }
[2741](#2741)
[2742](#2742)    #[test]
[2743](#2743)    fn limit_is_clamped() {

[2746](#2746)        p.insert("limit".to_string(), "100000".to_string());
[2747](#2747)        let (_, _, limit, _) = parse_list_query(&m, &p).unwrap();

Full router: metadata routes plus secured CRUD data endpoints. `auth_secret` is the HS256
secret used to verify the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` of each data request into a `Ctx`.
No PDF rasterizer is configured (report `?format=pdf` answers 501); see
[ router_with_data_rasterized](https://docs.rs/fn.router_with_data_rasterized.html) to attach one.
